description: The workouts suggested through this connection, newest first, and what became of each: pending, approved, rejected, or expired (unanswered for a week, or past its day). action says which kind each was: plan (a session on a day), save (a named workout to keep) or remove (a saved one taken away). For an approved one, approved_exercises is what the person approved and edited says whether they changed it; workout_ids are the workouts it was run as, and get_workout has what was actually done.

client.description: For a coach: a client id from list_clients, to read that client. Omitted: your own account.
